title: Farm to Table: More Than a Trend - Trovara Farm
description: Farm to Table is more than a promise of fresher food. Drawing from a personal experience and the realities of Nigeria’s food system, we explore how shorter supply chains can improve traceability, reduce waste, create better value for farmers and consumers, and why this principle sits at the heart of how we are building Trovara.

title: Why Trovara Exists - Trovara Farm
description: Why does Trovara exist? Because we believe a food system cannot be considered successful when consumers pay more, farmers earn unpredictably and too much food never reaches the table. This article explores the challenges shaping Nigeria's food system and the vision behind building a trusted, regenerative food company designed for tomorrow.

title: What if agriculture was more than food production? - Trovara Farm
description: Trovara is building a regenerative food company in Ogun State, Nigeria to reconnect people with the land through better food, better livelihoods, and stronger communities.

title: Farm Analyst - Careers - Trovara Farm
description: Support the records, inventory and quality systems behind Trovara’s growing farm operations. This NYSC placement offers hands-on exposure to agricultural production, inventory management, food processing, quality control, traceability and farm technology.

title: Farm Operations Supervisor - Careers - Trovara Farm
description: Lead day-to-day farm operations across crop, livestock and processing activities while helping build the systems, team and standards behind Trovara’s next-generation food business.

title: NYSC Placement – Poultry Operations Supervisor - Careers - Trovara Farm
description: Join Project Feather, Trovara’s pasture-based poultry programme, and support daily poultry operations while gaining hands-on experience in a modern, data-driven commercial farm.

title: Project Canopy – Agricultural & Agroforestry Consultant - Careers - Trovara Farm
description: Lead the technical design and establishment of Project Canopy – Phase 1, including agroforestry planning, nursery establishment, tree planting, staff training and an oil palm estate rehabilitation assessment.
